symbols.description: Create a media player or recorder.
symbols.signature:
function create(controllerId: typeof id.PLAYER): Player
function create(controllerId: typeof id.RECORDER): Recorder

symbols.description: The media player controller sets audio sources, prepares playback resources, controls playback, and reads media information..

members.name: setSource
members.description: Set playback parameters and specify the audio file path before playback starts. `player.source.FILE` supports MP3 files and OPUS files recorded with the audio API. `options.file` is relative to the mini program `assets` directory by default; use `data://` to access the `data` directory.
members.signature: setSource(source: Player['source']['FILE'], options: { file: string }): void

members.name: prepare
members.description: Prepare the player by checking the path, file format, and supported bitrate. On success, the player changes state and starts buffering media data; use the event listener to get the result.

members.name: start
members.description: Start playback

members.name: pause
members.description: Pause playback

members.name: resume
members.description: Resume playback; has the same effect as calling `start()`

members.name: stop
members.description: Stop playback

members.name: seek
members.description: Set the playback position as a percentage of the total duration. `percentage` must be in [0 - 100]; the return value indicates whether the position was set successfully. - In `PREPARED`, playback starts automatically after `seek()` - In `PAUSED` or `PLAY`, the current state is preserved after `seek()`

members.name: seekTo
members.description: Set the playback position in seconds; equivalent to `seek()`

members.name: getDuration
members.description: Get the total duration of the current media file in seconds. A return value of `0` is invalid; the player must be in `PREPARED` to get the duration

members.name: getVolume
members.description: Get the current system volume in the range [0 - 100]

members.name: setVolume
members.description: Set the system volume in the range [0 - 100]. The return value indicates whether the setting succeeded; `true` means success

members.name: getTitle
members.description: Get the title of the current media file; returns `undefined` on failure

members.name: getArtist
members.description: Get the artist of the current media file; returns `undefined` on failure

members.name: getMediaInfo
members.description: Get the title, artist, and duration of the current media file. `title` and `artist` are available after `setSource()`; `duration` requires the player to be in `PREPARED`

members.name: getStatus
members.description: Get the player state; see `player.state` for the meanings

members.name: addEventListener
members.description: Listen for playback state changes; `callback` is triggered when the state changes
members.signature: addEventListener(event: number, callback: (result: boolean | number | undefined) => void): void

symbols.description: The media recorder controller records audio to a file in the mini program `data` directory..

members.name: setFormat
members.description: Set the recording format and output file. Use a value from `codec`; `codec.OPUS` is currently supported. `options.target_file` specifies the output path in the mini program `data` directory, for example `data://record_file.opus`
members.signature: setFormat(codecValue: typeof codec.OPUS, options: { target_file: string }): void

members.name: start
members.description: Start recording

members.name: stop
members.description: Stop recording

members.name: getStatus
members.description: Get the recorder state; see `recorder.state` for the meanings

members.name: addEventListener
members.description: Listen for recorder state changes; `callback` is triggered when the state changes
members.signature: addEventListener(event: number, callback: (result: boolean | undefined) => void): void
